Anthony Davidson's only teammate at Super Aguri in 2008 was **Takuma Sato**. The knowledge graph lists Sato as his sole teammate for the season, and the Super Aguri 2008 entry lists only Davidson and Sato as drivers.

The data doesn't show race-by-race participation, so I can't confirm from it whether anyone else shared the car for part of the year. The answer rests on the graph listing Sato as the only teammate.

ANSWER: Takuma Sato
